source.note: Undocumented and unsupported. Can change without warning.

selection._comment_odds: 1.40 = -250, 1.667 = -150. This wider favourite-only window produces more selectable ladder options without dropping below -150.
selection._comment_leagues: Any of: nfl ncaaf mlb nba wnba ncaab nhl mls epl ucl atp wta. Tennis odds on ESPN are sparse; golf is outrights only, so neither reliably produces a -150/-200 moneyline.

ladder._comment_max_rung: Cash out after this many straight wins. At 10 rungs and ~1.55 odds the final stake is around $400, so max_stake is set as a backstop.
ladder._comment_stake: stake_increment rounds stakes DOWN so you never overstake. 0.01 keeps compounding exact; 0.25 or 1.00 gives tidier numbers but leaks value at every rung.
ladder._comment_guards: Multiple rungs may be played in one day, but only one bet may be pending at a time. stop_loss_busts halts the ladder after N busted runs in stop_loss_days; `ladder resume` restarts it deliberately.
